verdict.rationale: Stripe is a SaaS payments platform, so an official MCP server is a fair axis, and a probe confirms one is documented at docs.stripe.com/mcp. The only evidence is that single probe line, with no detail on its tools, auth, or whether it covers crypto and stablecoin operations. Missing for 10: documentation of MCP tool coverage for stablecoin payments, payouts and onramp, setup or authentication details, and independent hands-on corroboration.
